keyboard.board: Dots and Boxes board. Arrow keys move between lines, Enter draws a line

dotsandboxes.title: Dots and Boxes
dotsandboxes.description: Connect dots to complete boxes! Claim more boxes to win.
dotsandboxes.sharePeerId: Share this Peer ID with your opponent:
dotsandboxes.directConnectDesc: Enter the host's Peer ID to join directly.
dotsandboxes.confirmSurrender: Are you sure you want to surrender?

rules.rule1: Take turns drawing lines between dots.
rules.rule2: Complete the fourth side of a box to claim it.
rules.rule3: When you complete a box, you get another turn.
rules.rule4: The player with the most boxes wins!
rules.objectiveDesc: Complete more boxes than your opponent.
rules.gameplayDesc: Take turns drawing lines between adjacent dots.
rules.scoringDesc: Complete a box by drawing its 4th side to claim it and get an extra turn.
rules.endDesc: Game ends when all boxes are claimed. Player with more boxes wins.
